title: Enderpearl.de
description: Enderpearl is a German Minecraft server since 2021. Java (1.21–1.26) & Bedrock with full crossplay — PC, console & mobile. BedWars, CityBuild, BuildFFA & more. Free, no pay-to-win. IP: enderpearl.de
body:
Enderpearl is a German Minecraft server running since 2021. We support Java Edition (1.21 to 1.26) and Bedrock Edition with full crossplay support — PC, console, and mobile players can all join and play together. We offer BedWars, CityBuild, BuildFFA, and KnockbackFFA with more game modes in development. Our goal is a long-term project with stable infrastructure, clean configuration, and regular updates. No pay-to-win, free to play. Perfect for players looking for a reliable German Minecraft server with crossplay.

IP: enderpearl.de | Java 1.21-1.26 | Bedrock | Crossplay | German | BedWars | CityBuild | Minigames | Long-term
